map.Shell 对空白极其敏感：if [ ... ] 里方括号两侧必须有空格、变量赋: Shell is extremely whitespace-sensitive: in `if [ ... ]` the brackets need spaces on both sides, variable assignment must have no spaces around `=`, and a line-continuation `\` must have nothing after it (including spaces). A formatter that doesn't know these rules can break the script. So after formatting, run shellcheck and actually run it in a test environment before going live.

map.按行遍历脚本并维护缩进深度。先处理 here 文档：命中「重定向符加定界符」的行: Iterate line by line while tracking indent depth. Heredocs are handled first: a line containing a redirection plus delimiter is emitted as-is and enters heredoc mode until a line equal to the delimiter (or equal after removing quotes) appears; every line in between is preserved. Ordinary lines are trimmed and emitted, and consecutive blank lines collapse to one. Indent rules: a line starting with fi, done, or esac, or with else or elif, or consisting of a terminator such as ;; reduces the current depth by 1 (not below 0). After emitting, depth increases by 1 for lines starting with if, for, while, until, or case, ending with an opening brace, ending with then or do, or consisting only of an opening brace; case branch patterns ending with a closing parenthesis add another 1; lines that are fi, done, or esac, start with a closing brace, or consist only of a closing brace reduce depth by 1; terminators reduce it by another 1. Output joins indent unit × depth with the trimmed line.
